blocks.p: This policy explains what business expenses Delcorn will reimburse and how to claim them. It applies to all employees, fixed-term staff and associate coaches engaged directly by Delcorn. Use Teams for meetings wherever possible; travel only when being there in person adds clear value (e.g. employer site visits, observations, hub away-days, workshops).

title: Annual Leave Policy
author: P031
summary: Annual leave entitlement (27 days plus bank holidays, rising with service to 30), the wellbeing day, booking rules and the 5-day carry-over limit.

version_history.change: Clarified carry-over deadline and coach booking rules around EPA peaks

blocks.p: Rest matters. This policy sets out how much annual leave you receive, how to book it and what happens to leave you have not used. It applies to all employees. Leave is recorded in **PeopleFlow**.
The leave year runs from **1 January to 31 December**. (Note: this differs from Delcorn's financial year, which ends 31 July.)
Full-time employees receive **27 days' annual leave plus the eight UK bank holidays** (or the Scottish/Northern Irish equivalents where you live there). Part-time entitlement is pro rata to your FTE.
You gain **one extra day for every two complete years of service**, up to a maximum of **30 days** (plus bank holidays). The extra day is added on 1 January following your service anniversary.

Everyone receives **one wellbeing day** per leave year in addition to annual leave. Take it whenever you need it with at least 48 hours' notice — no reason needed. It cannot be carried over or paid in lieu.

If you join or leave part-way through the year, entitlement is calculated pro rata (rounded up to the nearest half day). On leaving, untaken leave is paid; leave taken in excess of accrued entitlement is deducted from final pay.

bullets: Request leave in PeopleFlow at least **twice the length of the leave in advance** (e.g. two weeks' notice for one week off).
Managers respond within 5 working days. Requests are generally approved on a first-come basis.
Skills coaches must rearrange any learner reviews and workshops falling in the period and note cover arrangements in Aptiva.

Coaches should avoid more than 5 consecutive days' leave in the last two weeks of July and the first two weeks of September (peak gateway and new-start periods) unless agreed with the Head of Delivery.
No more than two weeks (10 days) may be taken consecutively without Head of function approval.

blocks.p: Delcorn closes between Christmas and New Year. Staff must reserve **three days** of annual leave for the closure period (29–31 December 2026 for this leave year). These are deducted automatically in PeopleFlow.

We want you to use your leave within the year. You may carry over **up to 5 days** of unused annual leave into the next leave year. Carried-over days must be taken by **31 March**; any carried-over days not taken by then are lost.

bullets: Carry-over above 5 days is only permitted in exceptional circumstances (e.g. long-term sickness or family leave prevented you taking leave) and must be approved by the **People Director**.
Statutory rights are protected: if sickness or family leave meant you could not take your statutory 5.6 weeks, that leave carries over in line with the law.
Bank holidays and the wellbeing day cannot be carried over.

blocks.callout: Leave balances are frozen in PeopleFlow on 31 December. Up to 5 days roll forward automatically; anything above that is removed unless an exception has been approved before 15 December.
blocks.title: Year-end

blocks.p: Through the annual benefits window (November), you may buy up to 5 extra days (deducted from salary across the year) or sell up to 3 days, provided you still take at least 28 days including bank holidays.

If you are ill during annual leave, tell your manager on the first day of illness and provide a fit note (or self-certification for up to 7 days). The days will be recorded as sickness and reinstated as leave.

title: Sickness Absence Policy
author: P031
summary: How to report sickness, company sick pay, return-to-work meetings and the Bradford factor triggers for absence reviews.

blocks.callout: This policy passed its review date on 13 October 2026. A refreshed version (v2.2) is with Amy Collins for consultation; v2.1 remains in force until it is replaced.
blocks.title: Review status

blocks.p: We want to support colleagues who are unwell, help them return to work safely, and manage frequent short-term absence fairly and consistently.

numbered: Call or Teams-call your line manager **before 09:30** on your first day of absence (a message is acceptable only if you are unable to speak).
Skills coaches must also tell their manager which learner sessions need rescheduling so the coaching team can notify learners and employers.
Record the absence in PeopleFlow on your return (or your manager will do it).
Self-certify for absences of up to 7 calendar days. From day 8 you need a fit note from a GP or other healthcare professional.

table.caption: Table 1 — Company sick pay in any rolling 12 months

blocks.p: Managers hold a short, supportive return-to-work conversation after **every** absence, ideally on the first day back, and record it in PeopleFlow. The aim is to check you are fit to work, understand any underlying cause and agree any adjustments.

blocks.h1: 5. Bradford factor and absence review triggers

blocks.p: To manage frequent short-term absence fairly, PeopleFlow calculates a **Bradford factor** score over a rolling 52 weeks: **B = S² × D**, where S is the number of separate spells of absence and D is the total days absent. Frequent short spells score higher than a single longer absence.

rows: Informal conversation with line manager to understand causes and offer support
**Stage 1 formal absence review** meeting; improvement period of 3 months
Stage 2 absence review; HR Business Partner attends; Occupational Health referral considered
Stage 3 final review; possible outcomes include final written warning or dismissal on capability grounds
table.caption: Table 2 — Bradford factor triggers

blocks.p: Example: 4 spells totalling 8 days gives 4 × 4 × 8 = **128**, which triggers a Stage 1 review. One spell of 10 days scores 1 × 1 × 10 = 10.

blocks.callout: Triggers prompt a conversation, not an automatic sanction. Absences related to disability, pregnancy, IVF treatment or an accepted workplace injury are discounted or adjusted, and managers must take HR advice before any formal stage.
blocks.title: Use with judgement

blocks.p: Absence of four weeks or more is long-term. HR and your manager will keep in regular agreed contact, refer to Occupational Health, and plan a phased return where appropriate (typically over 2–4 weeks on full pay).

title: Disciplinary & Grievance Procedure
author: P031
summary: ACAS-aligned procedure for handling misconduct and staff grievances, including stages, timescales, right to be accompanied and appeals.

blocks.p: This procedure follows the **ACAS Code of Practice on Disciplinary and Grievance Procedures**. It helps managers deal with conduct issues fairly and gives employees a clear route to raise concerns. Performance (capability) and sickness are handled under separate procedures.

bullets: Issues are resolved informally where possible.
No disciplinary action is taken until the matter has been investigated.
Employees are told the allegations and given evidence in advance of any hearing.
Employees may be accompanied by a colleague or trade union representative at formal meetings.
Meetings may take place on Teams; recordings are not made without everyone's consent.

numbered: **Investigation** — an investigating manager (not the hearing manager) gathers facts, normally within 10 working days.

**Hearing** — chaired by a manager with HR present; the employee states their case.
**Outcome** — confirmed in writing within 5 working days.
**Appeal** — in writing within 7 working days to a more senior manager not previously involved.

bullets: **Human review is mandatory.** Read, check and edit everything Copilot produces before you use, send or publish it.
Check facts, figures and dates against the source — use the citations Copilot provides.
Do not rely on Copilot for funding eligibility, safeguarding, HR or legal decisions. It can help draft; a qualified person decides.

Coaches may use Copilot to draft progress review summaries from their own notes in Aptiva exports or Word. The coach must edit the draft so it reflects their own professional judgement, then sign it in Aptiva.

bullets: Tell people when AI has materially contributed to content they receive, where it matters — for example: '*Drafted with Microsoft 365 Copilot and reviewed by [name]*' on reports, proposals and learner-facing resources.

Learners must be told how AI is used in their programme (see the Learner AI Guidance in the Curriculum site).
Do not record or transcribe meetings with learners or employers without telling participants at the start.

Personal data breaches are assessed by the DPO, who decides on ICO notification within 72 hours.

Suppliers processing Delcorn data must pass a security questionnaire, sign a data processing agreement and hold Cyber Essentials (or equivalent). Critical suppliers (Aptiva, PeopleFlow, Ledgerline, PipelineHQ) are reviewed annually.

title: Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery Plan
author: P007
summary: How Delcorn keeps delivering to learners during disruption: critical services, RTO/RPO targets, incident roles, scenarios and testing.

blocks.p: This plan sets out how Delcorn responds to and recovers from disruption — cyber attack, supplier outage, loss of key staff or premises — so that learners continue to receive coaching, safeguarding duties are met and funding returns are submitted on time.

kv: Jess Morgan, Head of Marketing & Communications

blocks.p: The incident lead convenes the team on a Teams bridge (fallback: WhatsApp group 'Delcorn IMT' and personal mobiles listed in the offline contact sheet) within **30 minutes** of a major incident being declared.

numbered: Isolate affected devices via Intune; disable compromised accounts; revoke sessions.
Engage the cyber insurer's incident response retainer (policy CYB-77213).
DPO assesses personal data impact; ICO notification decision within 72 hours.
Restore from immutable backups (Microsoft 365 backup retained 30 days; Aptiva vendor snapshots every 4 hours).

bullets: Coaches continue sessions on Teams and record notes in the offline Progress Review template (Word) in their OneDrive.
Notes are uploaded to Aptiva within 2 working days of restoration.
If the outage spans an ILR deadline, the Funding & MI Analyst notifies the DfE and submits from the last good extract.
Check the Microsoft 365 service health dashboard and the status page.
Use Aptiva messaging and phone for learner contact.
Safeguarding referrals by phone to the DSL duty mobile 07700 900 412.

blocks.p: Each critical service has a named deputy. Coach caseloads are reassigned by Delivery Managers within 5 working days; learners are notified by email.

author: P034
summary: Self-service answers to the most common IT questions (passwords, MFA, Teams audio, Aptiva sync, Copilot licences) plus current known issues and how to raise a FixDesk ticket.

blocks.p: Use self-service password reset at **aka.ms/sspr** from any browser. You'll need your registered Authenticator app or mobile number. If you're locked out of both, call the Service Desk — we'll verify your identity with your line manager before resetting.

blocks.h3: I've got a new phone — how do I move Microsoft Authenticator?

blocks.p: Before wiping your old phone, go to **mysignins.microsoft.com > Security info**, add the new phone as an Authenticator method, then remove the old one. If you've already lost the old phone, raise a P2 ticket 'Password / MFA reset' and we'll issue a temporary access pass valid for 8 hours.

blocks.h3: I got an MFA prompt I didn't request

blocks.p: **Deny it** and report it immediately as a P1 (call 020 7946 0199). Someone may have your password. We'll reset it and review sign-in logs.

Central teams were licensed in Wave 1 on **2 November 2026**. Skills coaches and tutors are licensed in Wave 2 from **16 November 2026**. Your licence is assigned automatically once you complete the **Responsible AI & Copilot Essentials** module in the Delcorn Academy LMS — allow up to 24 hours after completion.

blocks.h3: I've completed the training but Copilot isn't showing in Word/Outlook

numbered: Wait 24 hours after completing training (group sync runs overnight).
Fully close Office apps, then sign out and back in (File > Account).
Check for updates: File > Account > Update Options > Update Now (Copilot needs the Current Channel).
In new Outlook, Copilot appears in the ribbon and in the message toolbar.
Still missing? Raise a ticket under **Copilot access & licensing** (P4).

blocks.h3: Copilot showed me a file I don't think I should see

blocks.p: Don't open, forward or quote it. Raise a **P2 'Data request'** ticket with the file name and location (or copy the citation link) so the owner can fix permissions. This is exactly what we want to catch.

blocks.h3: Why can't Copilot find a document I know exists?

blocks.p: Copilot only uses files you have access to, and Highly Confidential files and some restricted sites (Safeguarding Case Management, Executive & Board, parts of People & Culture) are excluded from Copilot search. Very new files can take a few hours to be indexed.

bullets: No sound: check the device selected in Teams > Settings > Devices; Delcorn headsets appear as 'Jabra Evolve2'.
Echo: ask others to mute or use headsets; turn off 'Noise suppression: Off'.
Can't join a learner's employer meeting: use 'Join on the web' if their tenant blocks guests.
Recordings and transcripts auto-delete after 120 days (Data Retention Schedule).

blocks.h3: Aptiva says 'Session expired' every few minutes

blocks.p: Clear the browser cache for aptiva.cloud and make sure you are signing in through the **Sign in with Microsoft** button (single sign-on), not the legacy username form.

blocks.h3: OTJ hours not syncing to the reporting dashboard

blocks.p: The reporting database refreshes nightly at 02:00. Hours logged today will appear tomorrow. If hours are still missing after 48 hours, raise 'Aptiva access / sync' with the learner ID (never the learner's name in the ticket title).

bullets: Request peripherals (second monitor, ergonomic mouse) through FixDesk > Request > Peripherals; standard items ship within 5 working days.
Laptop faults: raise 'Laptop hardware'; we'll send a replacement by next-day courier and a returns bag.
Lost or stolen laptop: report as P1 immediately so we can wipe it remotely.

subject: Leeds hub away-day — hotel, meals and a question about carry-over
summary: Fatima Hussain asks HR about expenses for the AI & Data team away-day at the Leeds hub and carrying over unused leave; Amy Collins answers from the Expenses and Annual Leave policies.

messages.body:
Hi Amy,

Sam has booked the AI & Data Academies away-day at the Leeds hub on Thursday 26 November (10:00–16:00) and there's a team dinner the night before. I'm coming up from Birmingham, so a couple of questions before I book anything:

1. Can I stay over on the Wednesday night, and what's the hotel limit in Leeds?
2. Is the dinner covered, and do I claim lunch on the day?
3. Would it be better to drive (about 120 miles each way) or get the train?

Also, a separate one — I've still got 7 days of annual leave left for this year and with gateway prep I'm not sure I can use them all before Christmas. Can I carry them over?

Thanks,
Fatima

Hi Fatima,

Happy to help — all of this is in the Expenses Policy (v3.2) and Annual Leave Policy in the HR Policies library, but here's the short version.

Away-day expenses:
- Overnight stay: yes. Birmingham to Leeds is more than 2.5 hours door to door, so one night is allowed. The cap outside London is £110 per night including breakfast. Sam needs to pre-approve the stay in Ledgerline as it's an overnight.
- Team dinner: the evening team meal is covered up to £35 per head if Sam has had it pre-approved by Rachel (Head of function). One person pays and lists the attendees, so please don't claim your own dinner separately. If you eat on your own instead, the evening meal allowance is £30.
- Lunch on the day is provided centrally at the hub, so no lunch claim.
- Travel: standard-class rail booked 7+ days ahead is usually cheaper. Driving 240 miles at 45p per mile would be £108 plus parking, whereas an advance return is around £60. Please go for the train unless there's a good reason to drive.

Remember to submit everything in Ledgerline Expenses within 30 days, so by 26 December at the latest.

Carry-over: you can carry over up to 5 days into 2027, and they must be taken by 31 March 2027. Anything above 5 days is lost unless Marcus approves an exception, which is only for things like long-term sickness or family leave. Also note 3 days are reserved for the Christmas closure (29–31 December). Have a look at your PeopleFlow balance — if the 7 days doesn't already account for the closure, you'll need to book a couple more days before the end of the year.

Amy

That's really clear, thanks Amy. PeopleFlow says 7 days remaining after the closure days, so I'll book Friday 11 and Monday 14 December and carry the other 5 into January.

Train booked for Wednesday 25th — £58.40 return. Sam, could you approve the hotel when it comes through?

Fatima

Approved — I'll sign off the hotel in Ledgerline when you submit. Rachel has approved the team dinner at £35 a head; I'll pay and claim for the group. Leave on 11 and 14 December is fine too, just move your two Friday reviews.

Sam

subject: URGENT: Salary file visible org-wide — needs fixing before Copilot Wave 1
summary: The DPO tells the Director of Learning Technology that a Confidential salary benchmarking file is shared org-wide; they agree remediation before Copilot Wave 1 go-live on 2 November.

messages.body:
Aisha,

The second run of the data access governance report this afternoon flagged a critical finding (PR-014 in the permissions review workbook).

File: Salary Benchmarking 2026.xlsx
Location: People & Culture site > Recruitment > Reward
Label: Confidential
Sharing: a 'People in Delcorn with the link' link created on 18 May 2026
Content: named salaries, job titles and locations for all 142 staff

The audit log shows 23 people outside the People team opened it in the last 90 days, most of them recently, probably via the link being forwarded in a Teams chat. Once Wave 1 goes live on Monday, Copilot would happily answer 'what does X earn?' for anyone who has used that link, because the link grants them access.

I'd suggest we (1) remove the link today, (2) restrict the file to Marcus, Amy and Priya, (3) upgrade the label to Highly Confidential so it's excluded from Copilot for everyone else, and (4) check whether there are other files in the Reward folder with the same problem. I don't think this is reportable to the ICO — it's internal access by staff bound by confidentiality — but I'll log it in the breach register as an incident and do a proper assessment.

Can we talk first thing tomorrow?

Liam

Liam,

Thanks for catching this. It's exactly the scenario the readiness review was for. Agree with all four steps. Adding Marcus as the file owner.

Kate, could you remove the sharing link and break inheritance on the Reward folder tonight if you can, or first thing tomorrow at the latest? Please also run the same sharing-link check across the whole People & Culture site, not just Recruitment.

I don't want to delay Wave 1 for the central teams. But I do want Restricted Content Discovery switched on for the People site before Monday as a belt-and-braces measure, and PR-014 has to be closed before the Wave 2 go/no-go on 11 November.

Marcus, it would help to know why the link was created. If it was shared for the pay review working group, we should set up a proper private channel for them instead.

Aisha

Morning both,

My fault, I'm afraid. I created the link in May so that Priya could review the draft, and didn't realise it worked for anyone who had it. I suspect it was then forwarded in the pay review chat. I'm mortified, but really glad we found it before Copilot did.

I'm happy for the file to be restricted to me, Amy and Priya. I'll also send a short note to the 23 people reminding them of their confidentiality obligations. Liam, could you check the wording before it goes?

Marcus

All,

Done as of 09:50 today:
- Org-wide sharing link removed from Salary Benchmarking 2026.xlsx
- Reward folder inheritance broken; access is now Marcus, Amy and Priya only
- Restricted Content Discovery enabled on the People & Culture, Safeguarding and Executive sites
- Site-wide link scan: one more org-wide link found, on the EAP usage report (PR-016), now removed

Outstanding: the label on the salary file still says Confidential because the Highly Confidential label needs the owner to apply it (encryption). Marcus, could you change it from the sensitivity bar in Excel? I've left PR-014 as 'In progress' until that's done.

Kate

Thanks Kate, that's great.

I've logged this as incident DPI-2026-019 (internal oversharing, not reportable to the ICO), and I'll add a short anonymised case study to the Responsible AI training as a reminder to check sharing links.

Marcus, I've approved your note to the 23 recipients with one wording change. Once the label is upgraded I'll close PR-014.

Liam

title: Copilot Champions
summary: Copilot Champions share tips, questions and pitfalls during the pilot and Wave 1 rollout: prompts for reviews, citations, oversharing reports, Excel and agents.

messages.text: Morning Champions 👋 Wave 1 (central teams) goes live next Monday 2 Nov and Wave 2 (coaches and tutors) on 16 Nov. Please share your best tips here this week. We're turning them into the prompt library. Thank you for a brilliant pilot!

My go-to for review summaries: paste in your rough notes and ask: "Draft a progress review summary for a Level 4 Data Analyst apprentice using these notes. Use UK English, three short paragraphs: progress against KSBs, OTJ position, and SMART targets for the next 12 weeks. Don't add anything that isn't in my notes." That last line stops it inventing things. Then I edit it into my own words before signing in Aptiva.
Is it OK to use learner names in that prompt? I've been using initials to be safe.

@Chloe In Microsoft 365 Copilot, yes, it stays inside our tenant and is covered by the DPIA. Keep it to the minimum the task needs, though. Never include health, disability or safeguarding details, and never use names in any public AI tool. Section 5.2 of the AI Acceptable Use Policy has the details.

HR tip: ask Copilot Chat "what's the hotel cap in London according to our Expenses Policy?" and then CLICK THE CITATION. In the pilot it once quoted the old £150 figure from an email in my inbox rather than the policy (it's £160 since Aug 2025). Always check the source.

From the service desk side: if Copilot isn't showing in Outlook after you get your licence, it's almost always classic Outlook on an old update channel (KI-121). Switch to new Outlook or update Office. Please don't raise a P2 for it 🙂

Excel tip: Copilot in Excel works MUCH better if the data is formatted as a Table (Ctrl+T) and saved as .xlsx. I asked it "which academy has the most overdue reviews?" on the caseload export and it built the pivot for me. I still check the numbers against Power BI though.

Slightly awkward one: I asked Copilot to "summarise recent pay review discussions" for a curriculum costing and it came back with a salary spreadsheet from the People site?! I didn't open it. Who do I tell?

@Nathan Thank you, that's exactly the right instinct. Please raise a P2 'Data request' in FixDesk with the citation link. We're already on it (permissions review finding PR-014) and it's being locked down before Monday. Everyone: if Copilot shows you something you shouldn't see, don't open it or share it. Report it.
Meeting recap tip: in Teams, ask Copilot "list the actions with owners and due dates" rather than "summarise". You get a much more usable list for the minutes. Works only if transcription was on.

Reminder: licences are only assigned after the 60-min Responsible AI & Copilot Essentials module. 71% of Wave 1 have finished, so please nudge your teams. The live 'Copilot for Coaches' workshop is 19 Nov, sign up in the LMS.

Sneak peek: we're building an IT self-service agent in Copilot Studio grounded on the Service Desk FAQ. If it can't answer, it'll offer to raise a FixDesk ticket for you. Also an HR Policy Helper on the HR Policies library with Amy. Volunteers to test next week? 🙋
Count me in for testing. Will the HR agent be able to see my own leave balance in PeopleFlow, or just the policies?
@James Policies only for v1. Personal data from PeopleFlow would need its own DPIA and a connector. v1 will tell you where to check your balance.
